public_rationale: The records distinguish task automation from job replacement. Radiologist numbers grew in the US study, while Oxipit described autonomous reporting of selected examinations. Neither establishes whether even one radiologist job was replaced anywhere. The search found no qualifying counterexample, but that does not prove the universal claim.
limitations: Employment growth can coexist with individual displacement.
The workforce evidence covers US Medicare-enrolled providers, not the worldwide profession.
Marcus’s private knowledge cannot be independently established.
